page.layout: One column of running text on the right; no notes in the margins; running head in the centre top; page number at top left.

main_text.p: Attilius Calatinus, apud què Valerius in hunc modum egit: Confulem ea pugna in lectica claudum iacuisse, se autem omnib. imperatorijs partibus functum. Tunc Calatinus, prius quam Luctatius[?] causam suam ordiretur: Quaero, inquit, Valeri à te, si dimicandum, nec ne esset, contrarijs inter uos sententijs dissedisse[?]tis, utrū quod consul, an quod praetor imperasset, maius habiturum fuit momentum? Respondit Valerius: non facere se controuersiam, quin priores partes consulis essent futurae. Age deinde, inquit Calatinus, si diuersa auspicia ac-

page.notes: The running head is a decorated title in heavy type and could not be read with confidence. The page number reads "158", but the top numeral is partly obscured. The faint mark at the bottom left and the scattered specks in the left margin are stains or show-through, not printed text, so they are left out. "Luctatius" is printed with a ct ligature, and "dissedisse" is uncertain; the line-end hyphen after "dissedifse" is not clearly printed. The text is one paragraph because there is no indent before "Respondit".
